name: yserver-vscode
description: Work with your own yserver from VS Code: its state in the status bar, ask and run skills on your code with the local models, and control the box.

commands.title: yserver: Run a skill on the selection
yserver: Apply the last code block

yserver.baseUrl.description: Address of your OpenAI-compatible server, for example http://localhost:8080. The status bar extras need a gateway that serves /v1/system and /metrics.

yserver.apiKey.description: API key, if the server asks for one.

yserver.model.description: Model name sent with each request.

yserver.interactive.description: Send the header x-yllm-priority: interactive, so a gateway with a priority queue serves your requests before background work.

yserver.memory.description: Let a gateway with memory add its stored notes to your questions. Off by default: for coding they are rarely relevant, and they can bring private paths into answers. Sends x-yllm-memory: off when false.

yserver.maxTokens.description: Room for the answer, including the model's hidden reasoning.

yserver.skillsDirs.description: Folders of skills (<name>/SKILL.md), for example a clone of engineering-skills/skills.

yserver.rulesDir.description: Folder of Markdown rules sent with every request (Continue's format: alwaysApply or globs). Empty for none.

yserver.sshHost.description: SSH host of the server, for pausing and resuming background services.

yserver.pipelines.description: User services (systemd --user) to pause while you work, for example batch jobs that use the GPU.

yserver.pages.description: Pages to open from the menu: {"label": "url"}.
